RagShortTexts: Marienburg served as the Teutonic Order's colossal brick-Gothic headquarters commanding.

Variants.Content: Constructed along the Nogat River, Marienburg represented the architectural zenith of Teutonic defensive engineering. As the seat of the Grand Master, this immense brick-Gothic fortress integrated grand vaulted refectories, deep granaries, and triple-curtain wall defenses.
White mantles bearing black crosses rallied knight-brothers across Prussia, directing Baltic crusades and monopolizing regional amber revenues.
